title: Fate
description: One Edit observation's derived final Fate.

observation_id.description: Stable id for this edit observation.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

agent_harness.description: Which coding agent harness produced this fact.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

call_id.description: The edit tool-call id that joins this Fate to its decision.

score.description: The scorer result after clamping to [0, 1], before threshold mapping.

fate.description: The categorical final Fate assigned from the retention score.

external_lines_added.description: Accumulated external lines added from this edit through Session end. Null when any window in the tail lacks coverage.

external_lines_removed.description: Accumulated external lines removed from this edit through Session end. Null when any window in the tail lacks coverage.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.
